Name: Unofficial Einari's Portraits Content Patcher Patch
Author: JingPing99
Description:
[b]Description
[/b]This is an unofficial Content Patcher version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/137]Einari's Portraits Mod - All Villagers[/url].
It replaces the portraits of most of the villagers in Stardew Valley.
﻿
[b]Notes
[/b][list]
[*]Check out the original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/137]Einari's Portraits Mod - All Villagers[/url]﻿

[/list][list]
[*]The original mod was last updated in 2016 meaning that any new portraits or characters since then are not supported by the mod.
[/list]
[b]Install
[/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download the mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]
